purpose: INT-203 initial copy and read-only shadow comparison

copy.targetTablesNote: 152 business tables plus 3 migration control tables

method: Row-count, key-set, orphan and result-hash comparisons run read-only against source and shadow with the same grant predicate on both sides, including a constrained subject rather than admin-only full reads.
limits: The comparison runs at the data layer with an identical predicate. It does not replace the authorized end-to-end comparison through the Host BFF with a real session, which stays part of INT-306/INT-503 acceptance. Source remains the sole writer; no route, credential or business row changed.
